items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And Prince, he had that roughest and that goodest sound, like a Hawk, and we all started to be changing to Prince Robertson, and we tried to find everything that he ever recorded.

ctx.x: And if you really couldn't do a few slap tonguing licks, I mean then you really wasn't too hot, you know. And Prince, he had that roughest and that goodest sound, like a Hawk, and we all started to be changing to Prince Robertson, and we tried to find everything that he ever recorded.
Now I'd just like to say this, Budd, ask you this -- you're recognized as the greatest living
